      PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).Additive := inferInstance
  haveI : (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf X.ringCatSheaf.obj ⋙
      (evaluation (TopologicalSpace.Opens ↥X)ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat).obj (Opposite.op V)).Additive :=
    inferInstance
  -- (1) Element-level decomposition of the evaluated nerve differential.  All steps are
  -- term-chained (`Eq.trans`/`congrArg`) — no `rw` of a `have` against the goal, dodging the
  -- instance-path mismatch on the `Finset.sum` of the `Preadditive` hom group.
  have hpush : ∀ x : ToType (((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj
        (pushPullObj F
          ((coverCechNerveOver 𝒰).obj (Opposite.op (SimplexCategory.mk p))))).presheaf.obj
        (Opposite.op V)),
      ConcreteCategory.hom
          ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf X.ringCatSheaf.obj ⋙
              (evaluation (TopologicalSpace.Opens ↥X)ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat).obj (Opposite.op V)).map
            ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
                PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).map
              (AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.objD
                (CosimplicialObject.Augmented.drop.obj (CechNerve 𝒰 F)) p))) x =
        ∑ i : Fin (p + 2), (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) •
          ConcreteCategory.hom
            ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf X.ringCatSheaf.obj ⋙
                (evaluation (TopologicalSpace.Opens ↥X)ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat).obj (Opposite.op V)).map
              ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
                  PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).map
                ((CosimplicialObject.Augmented.drop.obj (CechNerve 𝒰 F)).δ i))) x := by
    intro x
    have h1 : (SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
          PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).map
          (AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.objD
            (CosimplicialObject.Augmented.drop.obj (CechNerve 𝒰 F)) p) =
        ∑ i : Fin (p + 2), (SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
            PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).map
          ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) • (CosimplicialObject.Augmented.drop.obj (CechNerve 𝒰 F)).δ i) :=
      Functor.map_sum _ _ _
    have h2 : (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf X.ringCatSheaf.obj ⋙
          (evaluation (TopologicalSpace.Opens ↥X)ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat).obj (Opposite.op V)).map
          ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
              PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).map
            (AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.objD
              (CosimplicialObject.Augmented.drop.obj (CechNerve 𝒰 F)) p)) =
        ∑ i : Fin (p + 2),
          (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf X.ringCatSheaf.obj ⋙
              (evaluation (TopologicalSpace.Opens ↥X)ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat).obj (Opposite.op V)).map
            ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
                PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).map
              ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) •
                (CosimplicialObject.Augmented.drop.obj (CechNerve 𝒰 F)).δ i)) :=
      (congrArg (fun m => (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf X.ringCatSheaf.obj ⋙
          (evaluation (TopologicalSpace.Opens ↥X)ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat).obj
            (Opposite.op V)).map m) h1).trans
        (Functor.map_sum _ _ _)
    refine (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom h2 x).trans ?_
    rw [abHom_finsetSum_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    have h3 : (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf X.ringCatSheaf.obj ⋙
          (evaluation (TopologicalSpace.Opens ↥X)ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat).obj (Opposite.op V)).map
          ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
              PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).map
            ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) •
              (CosimplicialObject.Augmented.drop.obj (CechNerve 𝒰 F)).δ i)) =
        (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) •
          (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf X.ringCatSheaf.obj ⋙
              (evaluation (TopologicalSpace.Opens ↥X)ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat).obj (Opposite.op V)).map
            ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
                PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).map
              ((CosimplicialObject.Augmented.drop.obj (CechNerve 𝒰 F)).δ i)) :=
      (congrArg (fun m => (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf X.ringCatSheaf.obj ⋙
          (evaluation (TopologicalSpace.Opens ↥X)ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat).obj
            (Opposite.op V)).map m)
        (Functor.map_zsmul _)).trans (Functor.map_zsmul _)
    exact (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom h3 x).trans rfl
  -- (2) Elementwise comparison through the product equivalence, coordinate by coordinate.
  ext x
  apply (sectionCechProductEquiv (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
    ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F) (p + 1)).injective
  funext σ'
  refine Eq.trans (sectionCech_objD_apply (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
    ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F) p
    (ConcreteCategory.hom (coreIso_objIso 𝒰 F p V).hom x) σ') (Eq.symm ?_)
  refine Eq.trans (sectionCechProductEquiv_apply (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
    ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F) (p + 1) _ σ') ?_
  refine Eq.trans (congrArg
      (ConcreteCategory.hom (Pi.π (fun σ : Fin (p + 2) → 𝒰.I₀ =>
        ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F).presheaf.obj
          (Opposite.op (⨅ l, (coverOpen 𝒰 (σ l) ⊓ V)))) σ'))
      (ConcreteCategory.comp_apply _ ((coreIso_objIso 𝒰 F (p + 1) V).hom) x)) ?_
  refine Eq.trans (congrArg
      (ConcreteCategory.hom (Pi.π (fun σ : Fin (p + 2) → 𝒰.I₀ =>
        ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F).presheaf.obj
          (Opposite.op (⨅ l, (coverOpen 𝒰 (σ l) ⊓ V)))) σ'))
      (congrArg (ConcreteCategory.hom (coreIso_objIso 𝒰 F (p + 1) V).hom) (hpush x))) ?_
  refine Eq.trans (congrArg
      (ConcreteCategory.hom (Pi.π (fun σ : Fin (p + 2) → 𝒰.I₀ =>
        ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F).presheaf.obj
          (Opposite.op (⨅ l, (coverOpen 𝒰 (σ l) ⊓ V)))) σ'))
      (map_sum (ConcreteCategory.hom (coreIso_objIso 𝒰 F (p + 1) V).hom) _ Finset.univ)) ?_
  refine Eq.trans (map_sum (ConcreteCategory.hom (Pi.π (fun σ : Fin (p + 2) → 𝒰.I₀ =>
      ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F).presheaf.obj
        (Opposite.op (⨅ l, (coverOpen 𝒰 (σ l) ⊓ V)))) σ')) _ Finset.univ) ?_
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  refine Eq.trans (congrArg
      (ConcreteCategory.hom (Pi.π (fun σ : Fin (p + 2) → 𝒰.I₀ =>
        ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F).presheaf.obj
          (Opposite.op (⨅ l, (coverOpen 𝒰 (σ l) ⊓ V)))) σ'))
      (map_zsmul (ConcreteCategory.hom (coreIso_objIso 𝒰 F (p + 1) V).hom) _ _)) ?_
  refine Eq.trans (map_zsmul (ConcreteCategory.hom (Pi.π (fun σ : Fin (p + 2) → 𝒰.I₀ =>
      ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F).presheaf.obj
        (Opposite.op (⨅ l, (coverOpen 𝒰 (σ l) ⊓ V)))) σ')) _ _) ?_
  congr 1
  have hleg := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (coreIso_comm_leg 𝒰 F V p i σ') x
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hleg
  rw [sectionCechProductEquiv_apply (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
    ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F) p
    (ConcreteCategory.hom (coreIso_objIso 𝒰 F p V).hom x)
    (σ' ∘ (SimplexCategory.δ i).toOrderHom)]
  exact hleg

    13	`coreIso_comm_coface`, `coreIso_comm_sum`, `coreIso_comm`.
    14	
    15	Split from `CechSectionIdentificationLeg` to allow both files to compile within
    16	the 10-minute heartbeat budget (the three lemmas totalled ~14 M HB).
    17	
    18	Depends on `CechSectionIdentificationLeg` (transitively Base).

    21	universe u
    22	
    23	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    24	
    25	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    26	
    27	open Scheme.Modules
    28	
    29	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
    30	
    31	-- (heavy lemma: high heartbeat budget; respectTransparency knob restores v4.31.0 speed)
    32	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
    33	set_option maxHeartbeats 6400000 in
    34	/-- **Per-coface square of the core comparison** (`lem:coreIso_comm_coface`): for each
    35	degree `p` and coface index `k`, the object isos intertwine the individual cofaces.
    36	Coordinatewise extensionality (`Pi.hom_ext`); the `σ'`-coordinate of the left side is the
    37	face restriction by the defining `Pi.lift_π` of the section-Čech cosimplicial map, and the
    38	right side is `coreIso_comm_leg`. -/
    39	lemma coreIso_comm_coface (𝒰 : X.OpenCover) [Finite 𝒰.I₀] (F : X.Modules)
    40	    (V : TopologicalSpace.Opens X) (p : ℕ) (k : Fin (p + 2)) :
    41	    (coreIso_objIso 𝒰 F p V).hom ≫
    42	        (sectionCechCosimplicial (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
    43	          ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F)).δ k =
    44	      (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf X.ringCatSheaf.obj ⋙
    45	            (evaluation (TopologicalSpace.Opens ↥X)ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat).obj (Opposite.op V)).map
    46	          ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
    47	              PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).map
    48	            ((CosimplicialObject.Augmented.drop.obj (CechNerve 𝒰 F)).δ k)) ≫
    49	        (coreIso_objIso 𝒰 F (p + 1) V).hom := by
    50	  ext x
    51	  apply (sectionCechProductEquiv (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
    52	    ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F) (p + 1)).injective
    53	  funext σ'
    54	  have hπ : (sectionCechCosimplicial (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
    55	        ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F)).map (SimplexCategory.δ k) ≫
    56	        Pi.π _ σ' =
    57	      Pi.π _ (σ' ∘ (SimplexCategory.δ k).toOrderHom) ≫
    58	        sectionCechFaceRestr (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
    59	          ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F) σ' k :=
    60	    Pi.lift_π _ σ'
    61	  have hL := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hπ (ConcreteCategory.hom (coreIso_objIso 𝒰 F p V).hom x)
    62	  have hR := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (coreIso_comm_leg 𝒰 F V p k σ') x
    63	  exact ((sectionCechProductEquiv_apply (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
    64	      ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F) (p + 1) _ σ').trans hL).trans
    65	    (((sectionCechProductEquiv_apply (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
    66	      ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F) (p + 1) _ σ').trans hR).symm)
    67	
    68	-- (heavy lemma: high heartbeat budget; respectTransparency knob restores v4.31.0 speed)
    69	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
    70	set_option maxHeartbeats 6400000 in
    71	/-- **Alternating-sum assembly of the core comparison square** (`lem:coreIso_comm_sum`):
    72	the full alternating-coface differentials are intertwined by the object isos.  Proved
    73	ELEMENTWISE (per the iter-067 dead-end note: no `Preadditive.comp_sum` against the bundled
    74	`AddCommGrpCat`-hom `objD`): both sides, evaluated at an element and a coordinate `σ'`, are
    75	the same finite alternating sum, matched summand-by-summand by `coreIso_comm_leg`. -/
    76	lemma coreIso_comm_sum (𝒰 : X.OpenCover) [Finite 𝒰.I₀] (F : X.Modules)
    77	    (V : TopologicalSpace.Opens X) (p : ℕ) :
    78	    (coreIso_objIso 𝒰 F p V).hom ≫
    79	        AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.objD
    80	          (sectionCechCosimplicial (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
    81	            ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F)) p =
    82	      (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf X.ringCatSheaf.obj ⋙
    83	            (evaluation (TopologicalSpace.Opens ↥X)ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat).obj (Opposite.op V)).map
    84	          ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
    85	              PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).map
    86	            (AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.objD
    87	              (CosimplicialObject.Augmented.drop.obj (CechNerve 𝒰 F)) p)) ≫
    88	        (coreIso_objIso 𝒰 F (p + 1) V).hom := by
    89	  haveI : (SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
    90	      PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).Additive := inferInstance
    91	  haveI : (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf X.ringCatSheaf.obj ⋙
    92	      (evaluation (TopologicalSpace.Opens ↥X)ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat).obj
    93	        (Opposite.op V)).Additive := inferInstance
    94	  rw [AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.objD,
    95	    AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.objD, Preadditive.comp_sum,
    96	    Functor.map_sum, Functor.map_sum, Preadditive.sum_comp]
    97	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    98	  intro k _
    99	  rw [Preadditive.comp_zsmul, Functor.map_zsmul, Functor.map_zsmul,
   100	    Preadditive.zsmul_comp]
   101	  congr 1
   102	  exact coreIso_comm_coface 𝒰 F V p k
   103	
   104	-- (heavy lemma: high heartbeat budget; respectTransparency knob restores v4.31.0 speed)
   105	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
   106	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
   107	/-- **The core comparison intertwines the Čech differentials** (`lem:coreIso_comm`).  Under the
   108	degreewise object isos `coreIso_objIso`, the alternating-coface differential of the evaluated
   109	backbone complex `(G_V ∘ Ψ) Č•(𝒰, F)` matches the alternating-coface differential of the
   110	concrete restricted section complex `Č•(𝒰', F)`.  The square is exactly the alternating-sum
   111	assembly `coreIso_comm_sum` (built from the per-coface squares `coreIso_comm_coface`, in turn
   112	from the per-leg naturality `coreIso_comm_leg`). -/
   113	lemma coreIso_comm (𝒰 : X.OpenCover) [Finite 𝒰.I₀] (F : X.Modules)
   114	    (V : TopologicalSpace.Opens X) (i j : ℕ) (hij : (ComplexShape.up ℕ).Rel i j) :
   115	    (coreIso_objIso 𝒰 F i V).hom ≫ (sectionCechComplexV 𝒰 F V).d i j =
   116	      (((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf X.ringCatSheaf.obj ⋙
   117	            (evaluation (TopologicalSpace.Opens ↥X)ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat).obj
   118	              (Opposite.op V)).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj
   119	          (((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
   120	              PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).mapHomologicalComplex
   121	            (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj (cechComplexOnX 𝒰 F))).d i j ≫
   122	        (coreIso_objIso 𝒰 F j V).hom := by
   123	  obtain rfl : i + 1 = j := hij
   124	  rw [Functor.mapHomologicalComplex_obj_d, Functor.mapHomologicalComplex_obj_d]
   125	  have hsec : (sectionCechComplexV 𝒰 F V).d i (i + 1) =
   126	      AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.objD
   127	        (sectionCechCosimplicial (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
   128	          ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F)) i :=
   129	    CochainComplex.of_d (fun n => (sectionCechCosimplicial (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V) ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F)).obj (SimplexCategory.mk n)) (AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.objD (sectionCechCosimplicial (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V) ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F))) i
   130	  have hX : (cechComplexOnX 𝒰 F).d i (i + 1) =
   131	      AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.objD
   132	        (CosimplicialObject.Augmented.drop.obj (CechNerve 𝒰 F)) i :=
   133	    CochainComplex.of_d (fun n => (CosimplicialObject.Augmented.drop.obj (CechNerve 𝒰 F)).obj (SimplexCategory.mk n)) (AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.objD (CosimplicialObject.Augmented.drop.obj (CechNerve 𝒰 F))) i
   134	  rw [hsec, hX]
   135	  exact coreIso_comm_sum 𝒰 F V i
   136	
   137	end AlgebraicGeometry

    46	        Pi.π _ σ' =

    48	        sectionCechFaceRestr (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
    49	          ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F) σ' k :=
    50	    Pi.lift_π _ σ'

    52	    ((sectionCechCosimplicial (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
    53	      ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F)).map (SimplexCategory.δ k) ≫

    58	/-- **Alternating-sum assembly of the core comparison square** (`lem:coreIso_comm_sum`):
    59	the full alternating-coface differentials are intertwined by the object isos. This follows
    60	by distributing composition and the additive evaluation functors over the finite sum, then
    61	applying `coreIso_comm_coface` to each summand. -/
    62	lemma coreIso_comm_sum (𝒰 : X.OpenCover) [Finite 𝒰.I₀] (F : X.Modules)
    63	    (V : TopologicalSpace.Opens X) (p : ℕ) :
    64	    (coreIso_objIso 𝒰 F p V).hom ≫
    65	        AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.objD
    66	          (sectionCechCosimplicial (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
    67	            ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F)) p =

    69	            (evaluation (TopologicalSpace.Opens ↥X)ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat).obj (Opposite.op V)).map
    70	          ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
    71	              PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).map
    72	            (AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.objD
    73	              (CosimplicialObject.Augmented.drop.obj (CechNerve 𝒰 F)) p)) ≫
    74	        (coreIso_objIso 𝒰 F (p + 1) V).hom := by

    76	      PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).Additive := inferInstance
    77	  haveI : (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf X.ringCatSheaf.obj ⋙
    78	      (evaluation (TopologicalSpace.Opens ↥X)ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat).obj
    79	        (Opposite.op V)).Additive := inferInstance
    80	  rw [AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.objD,
    81	    AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.objD, Preadditive.comp_sum,
    82	    Functor.map_sum, Functor.map_sum, Preadditive.sum_comp]
    83	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl

    86	    Preadditive.zsmul_comp]

    90	/-- **The core comparison intertwines the Čech differentials** (`lem:coreIso_comm`).  Under the
    91	degreewise object isos `coreIso_objIso`, the alternating-coface differential of the evaluated
    92	backbone complex `(G_V ∘ Ψ) Č•(𝒰, F)` matches the alternating-coface differential of the
    93	concrete restricted section complex `Č•(𝒰', F)`.  The square is exactly the alternating-sum
    94	assembly `coreIso_comm_sum` (built from the per-coface squares `coreIso_comm_coface`, in turn
    95	from the per-leg naturality `coreIso_comm_leg`). -/
    96	lemma coreIso_comm (𝒰 : X.OpenCover) [Finite 𝒰.I₀] (F : X.Modules)
    97	    (V : TopologicalSpace.Opens X) (i j : ℕ) (hij : (ComplexShape.up ℕ).Rel i j) :
    98	    (coreIso_objIso 𝒰 F i V).hom ≫ (sectionCechComplexV 𝒰 F V).d i j =
    99	      (((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf X.ringCatSheaf.obj ⋙
   100	            (evaluation (TopologicalSpace.Opens ↥X)ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat).obj
   101	              (Opposite.op V)).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj
   102	          (((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
   103	              PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).mapHomologicalComplex
   104	            (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj (cechComplexOnX 𝒰 F))).d i j ≫
   105	        (coreIso_objIso 𝒰 F j V).hom := by
   106	  obtain rfl : i + 1 = j := hij
   107	  rw [Functor.mapHomologicalComplex_obj_d, Functor.mapHomologicalComplex_obj_d]
   108	  have hsec : (sectionCechComplexV 𝒰 F V).d i (i + 1) =

   111	          ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F)) i :=
   112	    CochainComplex.of_d
   113	      (fun n => (sectionCechCosimplicial (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
   114	        ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F)).obj (SimplexCategory.mk n))
   115	      (AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.objD
   116	        (sectionCechCosimplicial (fun a => coverOpen 𝒰 a ⊓ V)
   117	          ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F))) i
   118	  have hX : (cechComplexOnX 𝒰 F).d i (i + 1) =
   119	      AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.objD
   120	        (CosimplicialObject.Augmented.drop.obj (CechNerve 𝒰 F)) i :=
   121	    CochainComplex.of_d
   122	      (fun n => (CosimplicialObject.Augmented.drop.obj (CechNerve 𝒰 F)).obj
   123	        (SimplexCategory.mk n))
   124	      (AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.objD
   125	        (CosimplicialObject.Augmented.drop.obj (CechNerve 𝒰 F))) i
   126	  rw [hsec, hX]

   396	  refine congrArg (fun m =>
   397	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p₁).unit.app F ≫ m) ?_
   398	  refine Eq.trans ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward p₁).map_comp _ _) ?_

   404	  apply Scheme.Modules.hom_ext

   130	        PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars α).mapHomologicalComplex cc).obj K
   131	    let GV :=
   132	      PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf X.ringCatSheaf.obj ⋙
   133	      (evaluation (TopologicalSpace.Opens X)ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat).obj (Opposite.op V)
   134	    let D := (GV.mapHomologicalComplex cc).obj Kp
   135	    D ≅ (sectionCechComplexV 𝒰 F V).augment (sectionCechAugV 𝒰 F V)
   136	      (sectionCechAugV_comp_d 𝒰 F V) := by
   137	  intro α cc K Kp GV D
   138	  -- The push–pull functor `Ψ` through which the evaluated complex `D` is built.  We keep it
   139	  -- inline (rather than abstracted by `set`) so the `Ψ.Additive` instance resolves directly.
   140	  haveI hΨadd :
   141	      (SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙ PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars α).Additive :=
   142	    inferInstance
   143	  haveI : GV.Additive := inferInstance
   144	  -- (CORE, residual) Non-augmented degreewise iso + differential match: the evaluated
   145	  -- non-augmented Čech complex `Γ(V, C•)` is the concrete section Čech complex over the
   146	  -- restricted family `U'_σ = coverInterOpen 𝒰 σ ⊓ V`.  Degreewise object iso is
   147	  -- `pushPull_eval_prod_iso` (Stub 4); the differential match is via `sectionCech_objD_apply`.
   148	  -- `coreIso` and `eY` are kept as `let`-bindings (transparent), so the degree-`0` identity
   149	  -- `(isoApp coreIso 0).hom = (coreIso_objIso 𝒰 F 0 V).hom` and `eY.hom = 𝟙` hold definitionally,
   150	  -- which is what makes `hcompat` close (the canonical `sectionCechAugV` is exactly the evaluated
   151	  -- Čech augmentation transported across `coreIso_objIso 0`).
   152	  let coreIso : (GV.mapHomologicalComplex cc).obj
   153	        (((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
   154	          PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars α).mapHomologicalComplex cc).obj
   155	            (cechComplexOnX 𝒰 F)) ≅ sectionCechComplexV 𝒰 F V :=
   156	    HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents (fun p => coreIso_objIso 𝒰 F p V)
   157	      (coreIso_comm 𝒰 F V)
   158	  -- (adapter) The augmentation node `GV(Ψ F)` is the section group `Γ(V, F)`: definitional,
   159	  -- since `restrictScalars (𝟙 ·)` and `toPresheaf` leave the underlying abelian-group presheaf
   160	  -- unchanged and evaluation extracts the section over `V`.
   161	  let eY : GV.obj ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
   162	        PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars α).obj F) ≅
   163	      ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F).presheaf.obj (Opposite.op V) := Iso.refl _
   164	  -- (compat) The evaluated Čech augmentation equals the canonical `sectionCechAugV` read through
   165	  -- `coreIso_objIso 0`; definitional, since `sectionCechAugV` is by construction
   166	  -- `GV(Ψ(cechAugmentation)) ≫ (coreIso_objIso 𝒰 F 0 V).hom` and `eY.hom = 𝟙`.
   167	  have hcompat : GV.map ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
   168	        PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars α).map (cechAugmentation 𝒰 F)) ≫
   169	        (HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoApp coreIso 0).hom = eY.hom ≫ sectionCechAugV 𝒰 F V := by
   170	    have happ : (HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoApp coreIso 0).hom = (coreIso_objIso 𝒰 F 0 V).hom :=
   171	      congrArg Iso.hom (HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents_app _ _ 0)
   172	    rw [happ, sectionCechAugV]
   173	    exact (Category.id_comp _).symm
   174	  -- Peel the augmentation node off `D` with `mapHC_augment_iso` (twice), then glue the
   175	  -- non-augmented `coreIso` to the augmentation data with `augmentCochainIso`.
   176	  exact (GV.mapHomologicalComplex cc).mapIso
   177	      (mapHC_augment_iso (SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
   178	          PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars α) hΨadd (cechComplexOnX 𝒰 F) (cechAugmentation 𝒰 F)
   179	        (cechAugmentation_comp_d 𝒰 F)) ≪≫
   180	    mapHC_augment_iso GV ‹GV.Additive› (((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
   181	        PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars α).mapHomologicalComplex cc).obj (cechComplexOnX 𝒰 F))
   182	      ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
   183	        PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars α).map (cechAugmentation 𝒰 F))
   184	      (map_augment_cond (SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
   185	        PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars α) hΨadd (cechComplexOnX 𝒰 F) (cechAugmentation 𝒰 F)
   186	        (cechAugmentation_comp_d 𝒰 F)) ≪≫
   187	    augmentCochainIso coreIso eY (GV.map ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
   188	        PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars α).map (cechAugmentation 𝒰 F)))
   189	      (map_augment_cond GV ‹GV.Additive› (((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
   190	          PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars α).mapHomologicalComplex cc).obj (cechComplexOnX 𝒰 F))
   191	        ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
   192	          PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars α).map (cechAugmentation 𝒰 F))
   193	        (map_augment_cond (SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
   194	          PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars α) hΨadd (cechComplexOnX 𝒰 F) (cechAugmentation 𝒰 F)
   195	          (cechAugmentation_comp_d 𝒰 F))) (sectionCechAugV 𝒰 F V)
   196	      (sectionCechAugV_comp_d 𝒰 F V) hcompat

   200	/-! ### Engine instantiation for Stub 6.
   201	
   202	The dependent-coefficient combinatorial Čech engine (`CombinatorialCech.depHomotopy_spec`,
   203	CechAcyclic.lean) is instantiated with the augmentation node `Γ(V, F)` as level `0` and the
   204	restricted Čech coefficients `Γ(⨅ₖ (U_{σ k} ⊓ V), F)` as levels `≥ 1`.  The coface maps `δ`
   205	are the presheaf face restrictions (level `0 → 1` is the augmentation restriction), and the
   206	prepend maps `c` are genuine restrictions because `V ≤ coverOpen 𝒰 i_fix` forces
   207	`U'_{i_fix·σ} = U'_σ`.  The `hu`/`hsh` compatibilities collapse to "two parallel restriction
   208	chains between the same opens agree". -/
   209	
   210	section Stub6Engine
   211	
   212	variable (𝒰 : X.OpenCover) (F : X.Modules) (V : TopologicalSpace.Opens X)
   213	
   214	/-- Composite of two presheaf restrictions is the direct restriction (local copy of the
   215	`CechBridge` private helper `restr_trans`). -/
   216	private lemma stubRestrTrans (P : (TopologicalSpace.Opens ↥X)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Ab.{u})
   217	    {A B C : TopologicalSpace.Opens ↥X} (h1 : A ≤ B) (h2 : B ≤ C)
   218	    (x : ToType (P.obj (Opposite.op C))) :
   219	    ConcreteCategory.hom (P.map (homOfLE h1).op)
   220	        (ConcreteCategory.hom (P.map (homOfLE h2).op) x)
   221	      = ConcreteCategory.hom (P.map (homOfLE (h1.trans h2)).op) x := by
   222	  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← P.map_comp, ← op_comp]
   223	  rfl
   224	
   225	/-- Two parallel presheaf restrictions agree (poset-hom uniqueness; local copy of the
   226	`CechBridge` private helper `restr_op_unique`). -/
   227	private lemma stubRestrUnique (P : (TopologicalSpace.Opens ↥X)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Ab.{u})
   228	    {A C : TopologicalSpace.Opens ↥X} (f g : Opposite.op C ⟶ Opposite.op A)
   229	    (x : ToType (P.obj (Opposite.op C))) :
   230	    ConcreteCategory.hom (P.map f) x = ConcreteCategory.hom (P.map g) x := by
   231	  rw [show f = g from Quiver.Hom.unop_inj (Subsingleton.elim _ _)]
   232	
   233	/-- A nonempty restricted Čech intersection is contained in `V`. -/
   234	private lemma stubInterLeV {m : ℕ} (σ : Fin (m + 1) → 𝒰.I₀) :
   235	    (⨅ k, (coverOpen 𝒰 (σ k) ⊓ V)) ≤ V :=
   236	  le_trans (iInf_le _ 0) inf_le_right
   237	
   238	/-- Prepending `i_fix` does not shrink the restricted intersection (positive levels). -/
   239	private lemma stubConsLe {m : ℕ} (i_fix : 𝒰.I₀) (hiV : V ≤ coverOpen 𝒰 i_fix)
   240	    (σ : Fin (m + 1) → 𝒰.I₀) :
   241	    (⨅ k, (coverOpen 𝒰 (σ k) ⊓ V)) ≤
   242	      ⨅ k, (coverOpen 𝒰 ((Fin.cons i_fix σ : Fin (m + 2) → 𝒰.I₀) k) ⊓ V) := by
   243	  refine le_iInf fun k => ?_
   244	  refine Fin.cases ?_ ?_ k
   245	  · rw [Fin.cons_zero]
   246	    exact le_trans (stubInterLeV 𝒰 V σ) (le_inf hiV le_rfl)
   247	  · intro j
   248	    rw [Fin.cons_succ]
   249	    exact iInf_le _ j
   250	
   251	/-- Prepending `i_fix` to the empty tuple yields an intersection containing `V`
   252	(the augmentation node case). -/
   253	private lemma stubConsLeZero (i_fix : 𝒰.I₀) (hiV : V ≤ coverOpen 𝒰 i_fix)
   254	    (σ : Fin 0 → 𝒰.I₀) :
   255	    V ≤ ⨅ k, (coverOpen 𝒰 ((Fin.cons i_fix σ : Fin 1 → 𝒰.I₀) k) ⊓ V) := by
   256	  refine le_iInf fun k => ?_
   257	  rw [Fin.fin_one_eq_zero k, Fin.cons_zero]
   258	  exact le_inf hiV le_rfl
   259	
   260	/-- The open underlying the level-`m` Stub-6 coefficient: level `0` is `V` (the
   261	augmentation node), level `m+1` is the restricted intersection `⨅ₖ (U_{σ k} ⊓ V)`. -/
   262	private def stubOpen : (m : ℕ) → (Fin m → 𝒰.I₀) → TopologicalSpace.Opens ↥X
   263	  | 0, _ => V
   264	  | _ + 1, σ => ⨅ k, (coverOpen 𝒰 (σ k) ⊓ V)
   265	
   266	/-- The coface inclusion of the Stub-6 opens. -/
   267	private lemma stubOpen_le_coface : ∀ {m : ℕ} (σ : Fin (m + 1) → 𝒰.I₀) (j : Fin (m + 1)),
   268	    stubOpen 𝒰 V (m + 1) σ ≤ stubOpen 𝒰 V m (σ ∘ j.succAbove)
   269	  | 0, σ, _ => stubInterLeV 𝒰 V σ
   270	  | _ + 1, σ, j => le_iInf fun l => iInf_le _ (j.succAbove l)
   271	
   272	/-- The prepend inclusion of the Stub-6 opens (prepending `i_fix` does not shrink the
   273	open, because `V ≤ coverOpen 𝒰 i_fix`). -/
   274	private lemma stubOpen_le_prepend (i_fix : 𝒰.I₀) (hiV : V ≤ coverOpen 𝒰 i_fix) :
   275	    ∀ {m : ℕ} (σ : Fin m → 𝒰.I₀),
   276	      stubOpen 𝒰 V m σ ≤ stubOpen 𝒰 V (m + 1) (Fin.cons i_fix σ)
   277	  | 0, σ => stubConsLeZero 𝒰 V i_fix hiV σ
   278	  | _ + 1, σ => stubConsLe 𝒰 V i_fix hiV σ
   279	
   280	/-- Dependent coefficient family for the Stub-6 engine: the sections of `F` over
   281	`stubOpen m σ`.  Kept as a reducible abbreviation so the `AddCommGroup` instance is the
   282	generic one on `Ab`-objects (no bespoke match-instance). -/
   283	private noncomputable abbrev cechSectionCoeff (m : ℕ) (σ : Fin m → 𝒰.I₀) : Type u :=
   284	  ToType (((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F).presheaf.obj
   285	    (Opposite.op (stubOpen 𝒰 V m σ)))
   286	
   287	/-- The engine coface maps: presheaf face restrictions (level `0 → 1` is the augmentation
   288	restriction `Γ(V) → Γ(U'_σ)`). -/
   289	private noncomputable def cechSectionCoface (m : ℕ) (σ : Fin (m + 1) → 𝒰.I₀)
   290	    (j : Fin (m + 1)) :
   291	    cechSectionCoeff 𝒰 F V m (σ ∘ j.succAbove) →+ cechSectionCoeff 𝒰 F V (m + 1) σ :=
   292	  ConcreteCategory.hom (((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F).presheaf.map
   293	    (homOfLE (stubOpen_le_coface 𝒰 V σ j)).op)
   294	
   295	/-- The engine prepend maps: genuine restrictions (level `1 → 0` is the restriction
   296	`Γ(U'_{(i_fix)}) → Γ(V)` along `V ≤ U'_{i_fix}`). -/
   297	private noncomputable def cechSectionPrepend (i_fix : 𝒰.I₀)
   298	    (hiV : V ≤ coverOpen 𝒰 i_fix) (m : ℕ) (σ : Fin m → 𝒰.I₀) :
   299	    cechSectionCoeff 𝒰 F V (m + 1) (Fin.cons i_fix σ) →+ cechSectionCoeff 𝒰 F V m σ :=
   300	  ConcreteCategory.hom (((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F).presheaf.map
   301	    (homOfLE (stubOpen_le_prepend 𝒰 V i_fix hiV σ)).op)
   302	
   303	/-- Transport of a Čech coefficient along an equality of index tuples is the canonical
   304	restriction between the (equal) intersection opens. -/
   305	private lemma cechSectionCoeff_transport {m : ℕ} {τ₁ τ₂ : Fin (m + 1) → 𝒰.I₀}
   306	    (h : τ₁ = τ₂)
   307	    (hle : stubOpen 𝒰 V (m + 1) τ₂ ≤ stubOpen 𝒰 V (m + 1) τ₁)
   308	    (y : cechSectionCoeff 𝒰 F V (m + 1) τ₁) :
   309	    (h ▸ y : cechSectionCoeff 𝒰 F V (m + 1) τ₂)
   310	      = ConcreteCategory.hom
   311	          (((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).obj F).presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op)
   312	          y := by
   313	  subst h
   314	  rw [show homOfLE hle = 𝟙 _ from Subsingleton.elim _ _, op_id,
   315	    CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
   316	  rfl
   317	
   318	/-- Unit compatibility `hu` for the Stub-6 engine: deleting the prepended `i_fix` and then
   319	applying the prepend restriction is the identity transport (both sides are restriction
   320	chains between the same opens). -/
   321	private lemma cechSection_hu (i_fix : 𝒰.I₀) (hiV : V ≤ coverOpen 𝒰 i_fix)
   322	    {m : ℕ} (σ : Fin (m + 1) → 𝒰.I₀)
   323	    (y : cechSectionCoeff 𝒰 F V (m + 1)
   324	      ((Fin.cons i_fix σ : Fin (m + 2) → 𝒰.I₀) ∘ (0 : Fin (m + 2)).succAbove)) :
   325	    cechSectionPrepend 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV (m + 1) σ
   326	        (cechSectionCoface 𝒰 F V (m + 1) (Fin.cons i_fix σ) 0 y)
   327	      = (CombinatorialCech.cons_comp_zero_succAbove i_fix σ) ▸ y := by
   328	  rw [cechSectionCoeff_transport 𝒰 F V (CombinatorialCech.cons_comp_zero_succAbove i_fix σ)
   329	    (le_of_eq (by rw [CombinatorialCech.cons_comp_zero_succAbove i_fix σ]))]
   330	  exact (stubRestrTrans _ _ _ y).trans (stubRestrUnique _ _ _ y)
   331	
   332	/-- Shift compatibility `hsh` for the Stub-6 engine: prepend commutes with the later
   333	cofaces (both sides are restriction chains between the same opens). -/
   334	private lemma cechSection_hsh (i_fix : 𝒰.I₀) (hiV : V ≤ coverOpen 𝒰 i_fix)
   335	    {m : ℕ} (σ : Fin (m + 1) → 𝒰.I₀) (k : Fin (m + 1))
   336	    (y : cechSectionCoeff 𝒰 F V (m + 1)
   337	      ((Fin.cons i_fix σ : Fin (m + 2) → 𝒰.I₀) ∘ (k.succ).succAbove)) :
   338	    cechSectionPrepend 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV (m + 1) σ
   339	        (cechSectionCoface 𝒰 F V (m + 1) (Fin.cons i_fix σ) k.succ y)
   340	      = cechSectionCoface 𝒰 F V m σ k
   341	          (cechSectionPrepend 𝒰 F V i_fix hiV m (σ ∘ k.succAbove)
   342	            ((CombinatorialCech.cons_comp_succAbove_succ i_fix σ k) ▸ y)) := by
   343	  have hle : stubOpen 𝒰 V (m + 1) (Fin.cons i_fix (σ ∘ k.succAbove)) ≤
   344	      stubOpen 𝒰 V (m + 1) ((Fin.cons i_fix σ : Fin (m + 2) → 𝒰.I₀) ∘ (k.succ).succAbove) :=
   345	    le_of_eq (by rw [CombinatorialCech.cons_comp_succAbove_succ i_fix σ k])
   346	  rw [cechSectionCoeff_transport 𝒰 F V
   347	    (CombinatorialCech.cons_comp_succAbove_succ i_fix σ k) hle]
   348	  refine Eq.trans (stubRestrTrans _ (stubOpen_le_prepend 𝒰 V i_fix hiV σ)
   349	    (stubOpen_le_coface 𝒰 V (Fin.cons i_fix σ) k.succ) y) ?_
   350	  refine Eq.trans (stubRestrUnique _ _ (homOfLE ((stubOpen_le_coface 𝒰 V σ k).trans
   351	    ((stubOpen_le_prepend 𝒰 V i_fix hiV (σ ∘ k.succAbove)).trans hle))).op y) ?_
   352	  refine Eq.symm ?_
   353	  refine Eq.trans (DFunLike.congr_arg (cechSectionCoface 𝒰 F V m σ k)
   354	    (stubRestrTrans _ (stubOpen_le_prepend 𝒰 V i_fix hiV (σ ∘ k.succAbove)) hle y)) ?_
   355	  exact stubRestrTrans _ (stubOpen_le_coface 𝒰 V σ k)
   356	    ((stubOpen_le_prepend 𝒰 V i_fix hiV (σ ∘ k.succAbove)).trans hle) y
   357	
   358	end Stub6Engine

   360	/-! ### Degree-0 augmentation seam — helper bricks for `sectionCechAugV_π`.
   361	
   362	The seam unwinds `sectionCechAugV ≫ Pi.π σ` through the proved Base seams.  The Čech
   363	augmentation composed with the push–pull of *any* `Over X`-morphism `g : Y ⟶ Y₀` into the
   364	backbone collapses — through the terminal object `Over.mk (𝟙 X)` of `Over X` — to the
   365	pullback–pushforward adjunction unit at `Y.hom` (`cechAugmentation_pushPullMap`); the unit, in
   366	turn, reads through the per-leg section identification `pushPull_leg_sections` as the plain
   367	presheaf restriction (`unit_pushPull_leg_sections`), because it is conjugate via
   368	`Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq` to the restriction adjunction whose unit *is* the restriction on
   369	sections (`Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app`). -/
   370	
   371	section AugSeam
   372	
   373	/-- An `eqToHom` between section groups of an abelian presheaf over (propositionally) equal
   374	opens is the presheaf restriction along the induced inclusion.  Transport-killer for the
   375	augmentation seam. -/
   376	private lemma stubEqToHomRestr (P : (TopologicalSpace.Opens ↥X)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Ab.{u})
   377	    {A B : TopologicalSpace.Opens ↥X} (hAB : A = B) (hle : B ≤ A)
   378	    (h : P.obj (Opposite.op A) = P.obj (Opposite.op B)) :
   379	    eqToHom h = P.map (homOfLE hle).op := by
   380	  subst hAB

380	  subst hAB
   381	  refine Eq.trans (eqToHom_refl _ h) ?_
   382	  refine Eq.trans (P.map_id (Opposite.op A)).symm ?_
   383	  exact congrArg P.map (congrArg Quiver.Hom.op (Subsingleton.elim (𝟙 A) (homOfLE hle)))
   384	
   385	/-- Precomposing the scheme-level push–pull comparison `rawPushPullMap` with the
   386	pullback–pushforward adjunction unit at the source structure map yields the unit at the
   387	target structure map (`η^{p₁} ≫ G(a) = η^{p₂}`, the mate-calculus collapse of the degree-`0`
   388	augmentation leg). -/
   389	private lemma rawPushPullMap_unit {Z₁ Z₂ : Scheme.{u}} (a : Z₂ ⟶ Z₁)
   390	    (p₁ : Z₁ ⟶ X) (p₂ : Z₂ ⟶ X) (w : a ≫ p₁ = p₂) (F : X.Modules) :
   391	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p₁).unit.app F ≫
   392	        rawPushPullMap a p₁ p₂ w F =
   393	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p₂).unit.app F := by
   394	  subst w
   395	  rw [rawPushPullMap_self, pushPull_unit_comp a p₁ F]
   396	  refine congrArg (fun m =>
   397	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p₁).unit.app F ≫ m) ?_
   398	  refine Eq.trans ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward p₁).map_comp _ _) ?_
   399	  refine congrArg (fun m => (Scheme.Modules.pushforward p₁).map
   400	    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction a).unit.app
   401	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback p₁).obj F)) ≫ m) ?_
   402	  -- `pushforward` is strict: `p₁_*(a_* χ) = (pushforwardComp).hom ≫ (a ≫ p₁)_* χ`
   403	  -- (the comparison cell is the identity on sections).
   404	  apply Scheme.Modules.hom_ext
   405	  intro U
   406	  rfl
   407	
   408	/-- The inverse of the Čech-nerve point identification is the pullback–pushforward
   409	adjunction unit of the identity morphism. -/
   410	private lemma cechNervePointIso_inv_eq_unit (𝒰 : X.OpenCover) (F : X.Modules) :
   411	    (cechNervePointIso 𝒰 F).inv =
   412	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (𝟙 X)).unit.app F := by
   413	  have star := unit_conjugateEquiv (Adjunction.id (C := X.Modules))
   414	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (𝟙 X)) (Scheme.Modules.pullbackId X).hom F
   415	  rw [Scheme.Modules.conjugateEquiv_pullbackId_hom] at star
   416	  simp only [Adjunction.id_unit, NatTrans.id_app, Functor.id_obj] at star
   417	  have star2 : (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardId X).inv.app F =
   418	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (𝟙 X)).unit.app F ≫
   419	        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (𝟙 X)).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackId X).hom.app F) :=
   420	    (Category.id_comp _).symm.trans star
   421	  have hnat := (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardId X).inv.naturality
